description_en: Apartment for sale on Shefqet Kuka street in Fresk 2+1+2 129m² apartment, 3rd floor. The apartment is organized with 1 living room, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. Gross area 129m2, Net area 114.9m2 Orientation from the west, Location 3 minutes from the big ring Extra works - Perimeter double brick wall with two bands of concrete and pressed polystyrene in the middle - Insulation of the entire surface + paving with first quality Italian tiles - Electrical works with Italian materials of the highest quality, quality LED, electric shutters etc. - Plumbing works from quality with Italian materials, first quality - Multisplit air conditioning line PRICE 173 million lek
